# Breadcrumb

Display the hierarchical path structure of a page with a navigational element.
See [Breadcrumb guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/breadcrumb/design/)

<Canvas of={BreadcrumbStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Dark Mode

<Canvas of={BreadcrumbStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

### Sizes

<Canvas of={BreadcrumbStories.Sizes} />

### Overflow

To avoid long breadcrumbs on several lines, use a popover to access intermediate levels.

<Canvas of={BreadcrumbStories.Overflow} />

```css
.h-140 {
  height: 140px;
}
.breadcrumb-popover {
  left: -84px;
  top: 44px;
}
```
